WITH invoiced_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    c.gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as order_count
  FROM Invoices i
  JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.gender
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(order_count) as total_orders
  FROM invoiced_orders
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    io.gender,
    io.order_count,
    CAST(io.order_count AS DECIMAL(19,4)) / CAST(t.total_orders AS DECIMAL(19,4)) as share
  FROM invoiced_orders io
  CROSS JOIN totals t
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(share) as avg_share_value
  FROM shares
)
SELECT 
  s.gender,
  s.order_count as count,
  s.share,
  s.share - a.avg_share_value as above_average
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avg_share a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share_value
